# Deleting spam text and voice messages from contact 9294880327
# IDs determined earlier by filtering search results for sender phone number.

spam_text_ids = [16802, 16796, 16810, 16814, 16808, 16806, 16804, 16800, 16798, 16794, 16812]
spam_voice_ids = [17028, 17036, 17026, 17030, 17022, 17024, 17034, 17032]

results = {'text': [], 'voice': []}

for tid in spam_text_ids:
    res = apis.phone.delete_text_message(access_token=phone_token, text_message_id=tid)
    print('deleted text', tid, '->', res)
    results['text'].append((tid, res))

for vid in spam_voice_ids:
    res = apis.phone.delete_voice_message(access_token=phone_token, voice_message_id=vid)
    print('deleted voice', vid, '->', res)
    results['voice'].append((vid, res))

print('done', {k: len(v) for k,v in results.items()})
